findings.claim: 10-K 載明 Advanced Products 營收相當大部分來自少數客戶；公司稱此集中反映技術採用早期，策略是先鎖定市場領先創新者。
findings.excerpt: While, overall, the Company has a broad customer base and sells into a variety of industries, a substantial portion of the Company’s revenue from its Advanced Products line has been derived from a limited number of customers. This concentration of revenue is a reflection of the relatively early stage of adoption of the technologies, architectures and products offered in the Advanced Products line

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：公司預期銷售將集中於相對更少的客戶，少數客戶的行動可能不成比例地影響經營結果。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1/1A（WebFetch 讀取）
findings.excerpt: we expect to experience a greater concentration of sales among relatively fewer customers.
